text: Unit auxiliary transformers (UAT): two transformers at 2 x 100 % (10BBT from the GT generator, 20BBT from the ST generator), connected between generator and generator circuit breaker so that the plant can run in house-load operation. Each UAT shall carry the full running plant load with the other out of service; the GT static frequency converter (start-up only) is supplied from 10BBT. The transformer ratings are in the records of 10BBT10 and 20BBT10 (DEC-EPCE-0016).
